parts: Blessed is the man who has not walked in the counsel of the wicked, nor stood in the way of sinners, nor sat in the seat of the pestilent. But his desire is in the Law of the Lord; and in His Law he will meditate day and night. And he shall be like the tree that is planted by the streams of water, which shall bring forth its fruit in its season; and its leaf shall not fall off; and whatsoever he does, he shall be pleased with. Not so, the wicked, not so: but (they are) like the dust which the wind drives away from the face of the earth. Therefore the wicked shall not rise up in the judgment, nor the sinners in the counsel of the righteous. For the Lord knows the way of the righteous: the way of the wicked shall perish. Alleluia.

Why have the nations cried out, and the people meditated vanities? The kings of the earth have stood up, and the rulers have gathered together to fight against the Lord, and against His Christ. Let us break their bonds, and let us cast away their yoke from us. He Who dwells in the heavens shall laugh at them: and the Lord shall scorn them. Then shall He speak to them in His anger, and trouble them in His wrath. But I was erected a king by Him on Zion, His holy mountain, to preach the commandment of the Lord. The Lord has said unto Me, You are my Son; this day have I begotten You. Ask of Me, and I shall give You the nations for Your inheritance, and Your dominion to the ends of the earth. You shall shepherd them with a rod of iron; You shall crush them like a clay vessel. Now, O you kings, understand. Be instructed, all you judges of the earth. Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice in Him with trem- bling. Embrace discipline, lest the Lord be angry, and you perish from the way of truth, when His wrath is quickly kindled. Blessed is everyone who trusts in Him. Alleluia.

Lord, why have those who afflict Me increased? Many have risen up against Me. Many say to My soul, There is no salvation for him in his God. But You, O Lord, You are my defender; my glory, and the lifter up of my head. With my voice have I cried unto the Lord, and He heard Me out of His holy mountain. But I laid down and slept; and I arose; for the Lord is He Who defends Me. I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that surround Me, who rise up against Me. Arise, O Lord; save Me, O My God: for You have smitten all them who are My enemies in vain. The teeth of the sinners You have crushed. Salvation is of the Lord: and His blessing is upon His people. Alleluia.

When I cried up, the God of my righteousness heard me. In distress You have enlarged me. Have compassion on me, O Lord, and hear my prayer. Sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart? Why do you love vanity, and seek after lying? Know that the Lord has made His holy One wonderful: the Lord will hear me when I cry unto Him. Be angry and sin not: what you say in your hearts, be sorry for upon your beds. Slay the sacrifice of righteousness, and trust in the Lord. There are many that say, Who will show us good things? The light of Your countenance, O Lord, has been signed upon us. You have given joy to my heart, more than those to whom were increased the fruit of their corn, their wine and their oil. In peace, I will also lie down, and sleep: for You, Lord, alone have made me dwell in hope. Alleluia.

Listen to my words, O Lord, and understand my cry. Hearken to the voice of my supplication, my King, and my God. For to You will I pray O Lord; in the morning You shall hear my voice. Early in the morning will I stand before You, and You shall see me. For You are a God Who desires not iniquity: neither shall evil doers abide in You, nor shall transgressors be established before Your eyes. O Lord, You have hated all workers of iniquity. You shall destroy every one that speaks lies. A bloody and deceitful man the Lord abhors. But as for me, in the multitude of Your mercy I will enter into Your house: and worship before Your holy temple in Your fear. Lead me, O Lord, in the way of Your righteousness because of my enemies; make my way straight before You. For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is vain; their throat is an open sepulchre; they have deceived with their tongues. Judge them, O God; may they fall by all their counsels; according to the multitude of their wickedness wipe them out; for they have angered You, O Lord. Let them be glad, all those that hope in You: they shall rejoice forever; and You shall abide in them. And they shall boast in You all those who love Your Name; for You, Lord, have blessed the righteous; as with the shield of good will You have crowned us. Alleluia

O Lord, rebuke me not in Your anger, neither chasten me in Your wrath. Have mercy upon me, O Lord; for I am weak: heal me, O Lord for my bones are troubled. And my soul is greatly troubled: but You, O Lord, until when? Return, deliver my soul: revive me for Your mercies' sake. For there is no one in death that remembers You: and who shall confess to You in Amenti? I am wearied in my groaning; every night I wash my bed; with my tears I water my sleeping-mat. My eyes became troubled because of anger; I have grown old among all my enemies. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping. The Lord has heard my supplication; the Lord has received my prayer. Let all my enemies be ashamed and be exceedingly troubled: let them be turned back and be greatly ashamed speedily. Alleluia.

O Lord our Lord, like wonder became Your Name upon all the earth! For Your splendour is exalted above the heavens. Out of the mouths of babes and sucklings You have prepared praise because of Your enemies, that You might still an enemy and an avenger. For I behold the heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, You have founded; what is man, that You are mindful of him? And the son of man, that You visit him? You have made him a little lower than the angels, with glory and honour You have crowned him. You have set him over the works of Your hands; You have subjected all things under his feet: all sheep and oxen, yea, and the cattle of the field; the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, that passes through the paths of the seas. O Lord our Lord, like wonder became Your Name upon all the earth! Alleluia.

Revive me, Lord; for the saint has ceased (to be); and the righteous have diminished from among the children of men. Vain things every one spoke with his friend: deceitful lips are in their hearts and with their hearts they have spoken. The Lord will cut off all the deceitful lips, and the tongue that speaks with pride: who have said, we will exalt our tongues; our lips are our own: who is lord over us? Because of the misery of the needy and the groaning of the poor, now will I arise, says the Lord; I will be in salvation and I will manifest Myself in it. The words of the Lord are pure words: silver that is fired, tried in the earth, purified seven times. But You O Lord, shall deliver us and guard us from this generation for ever. The wicked walk roundabout us; like unto Your Highness, You have increased the days of the children of men. Alleluia.

Until when, then, O Lord, will You forget me? for ever? Until when, then, will You turn away Your face from me? Until when, then, shall I take counsel in my soul, and have sorrow in my heart all the day? Until when, then, shall my enemy exalt himself over me? Behold and hear me, O Lord my God: enlighten my eyes, lest I sleep in death; lest my enemy say, I have prevailed over him. Those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved. But as for me, I have hoped in Your mercy; my heart shall rejoice in Your salvation. I will praise the Lord, Who has done good things to me and I will sing to the Name of the Lord Most High. Alleluia.

Lord, who shall abide in Your dwelling- place? Or who shall rest in Your holy mountain except he that walks blameless, and works righteousness, speaking truth in his heart? Who has not deceived with his tongue, neither has done evil to his friend, nor has taken up a reproach against his neighbours. A worker of evil is despised before him; but he glorifies those who fear the Lord. He that makes oath to his friend, and does not deny it. His silver he has not given at interest, nor received a bribe against the saints. He that does these things shall never be moved. Alleluia.

Guard me, O Lord: for in You have I hoped. I said to the Lord, You are my Lord: and You have no need of my goodness; He has manifested His wonders to His saints who are on His earth, and He has made all His desires in them. Their sicknesses have been multiplied, after these they have hastened: I will not assemble at their synagogues of blood, nor will I mention their names by my lips. The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and my cup: You are He Who shall restore my inheritance to me. The measuring cords are fallen to me among the mighty; and my inheritance is established for me. I will bless the Lord, who has given me understanding: till the night, also, my reins have instructed me. I preceded and beheld the Lord before me at all times: because He is at my right hand, I shall not be moved. Therefore my heart has been gladdened, and my tongue has rejoiced: moreover, my flesh also shall dwell in hope. For You will not leave my soul in Amenti; neither will You suffer Your Holy One to see corruption. You have instructed me in the ways of life: You will fill me with joy by Your countenance; at Your right hand there is gladness for evermore. Alleluia.

The heavens tell of the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims the creation of His hands. Day utters speech unto day and night manifests knowledge unto night. There are no words nor are there speeches: those whose voices are not heard. Their sound is gone out through all the earth, and their words have reached unto the end of the world. He has set His tabernacle in the sun, and He is like a bridegroom coming out of His bridechamber, Who will rejoice like a giant to run His course. His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his goal is unto the ends of the heaven: nothing can hide from the heat thereof. The Law of the Lord is pure, restoring the souls: the testimony of the Lord is faithful, teaching the little children. The truths of the Lord are upright, giving joy to the heart: the commandment of the Lord shines from afar, enlightening the eyes. The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring for ever: the judgements of the Lord are true and righteous altogether. The desires of His heart are more elect than gold, and much precious stone: and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb. Therefore, Your servant shall keep them and in keeping them there is great reward. Who can understand transgressions? Cleanse me, O Lord, from those hidden in me. From those that are not mine spare Your servant; if they have no dominion over me: then shall I be pure, and I shall be cleansed from a great sin. All the words of my mouth and the meditations of my heart shall be pleasing before You, at all times. The Lord is my helper, and my redeemer. Alleluia.

May the Lord hear you in the day of your trouble; may the Name of the God of Jacob defend you. May He send you help from the sanctuary, and support you out of Zion. May He remember all your sacrifices and may your burnt offerings be fattened before Him. May the Lord give you according to your heart, and fulfil all your counsel. We will confess to You, O Lord in Your salvation, and in the Name of our God we shall grow: the Lord will fulfil all your petitions. Now have I known that the Lord has saved His Anointed; He will hear Him from His holy heaven with the saving strength of His right hand. Some (trust) in chariots, and some in horses: but we shall grow in the Name of the Lord our God. They have stumbled and have fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright. O Lord save Your king, and hear us in the day when we call upon You. Alleluia.

The Lord will shepherd me; therefore I shall not be in want of anything. He has made me to dwell in a place of green pastures. He has brought me up on the water of rest. He has restored my soul: He has led me in the paths of righteousness for His Name's sake. Though I should walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I shall fear no evil: for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they have comforted me. You have prepared a table before me against those who afflict me. You have anointed my head with oil; and Your cup has inebriated me like strong drink. And Your mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and my dwelling (shall be) in the house of the Lord unto the length of days. Alleluia.

The earth is the Lord's, and its fulness; the world, and all they that dwell in it. He has founded it upon the seas, and has prepared it upon the rivers. Who shall ascend into the mountain of the Lord? Or who shall stand in His holy place? The holy in his hands, and the pure in his heart; who has not brought his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbour. Such a one shall receive a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God his Saviour. This is the generation of those who seek the Lord, who seek after the face of the God of Jacob. Lift up your gates; O you princes and be lifted up, O you eternal gates; and the King of glory shall enter in. Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in wars. Lift up your gates; O you princes and be lifted up, O you eternal gates; and the King of glory shall enter in. Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, He is the King of glory. Alleluia.

I have lifted up my soul unto You, O Lord. My God, I have put my trust in You: let me not be ashamed, neither let my enemies laugh at me. For all of those who wait on You shall not be ashamed: let them be ashamed that work iniquity in vain. Manifest unto me Your ways, O Lord; and teach me Your paths. Lead me in Your truth, and teach me: for You are God my Saviour; on You have I waited all the day. Remember, O Lord, Your compassions and Your mercies; for they are since the beginning. The sins of my youth and my ignorances remember them not; according to Your mercy remember me for Your goodness' sake, O Lord. For good and upright is the Lord: therefore will He set a Law for those who sin in the way. He will guide the meek in judgment, He will teach the meek His ways. All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth unto those who seek after His covenant and His testimonies. For the sake of Your Name, O Lord, You shall forgive me my sin; for it is great. Who is the man that fears the Lord? He shall set for him a Law in the way which has pleased (Him). His soul shall dwell among good things; and his seed shall inherit the earth. The Lord is the strength of those who fear Him; and His Name is for those who fear Him; His covenant will He manifest unto them. My eyes are looking to the Lord at all times; for He shall pluck my feet out of the snare. Look upon me, and have mercy on me; for I am an only son and I am poor. The troubles of my heart have multiplied: bring me out of my afflictions. Look upon my lowliness and my toil; and forgive me all my sins. Look upon my enemies; for they are multiplied; and they have hated me with a violent hatred. Guard my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I have hoped in You. The innocent and the upright have cleaved unto me; for I have waited on You, O Lord. Deliver Israel, O God, out of all his afflictions. Alleluia.

Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in my innocence: I have hoped in the Lord; (therefore) I shall not be weakened. Prove me, O Lord, and try me; fire my heart and my reins. For Your mercy is before my eyes: and I have been pleased in Your truth. I have not sat in the council of vanity, neither did I go in with breakers of the Law. I have hated the congregation of evil doers; neither did I sit with the wicked. I will wash my hands in holiness: and I will compass Your altar, O Lord: that I may hear the voice of Your praise, and declare all Your wonders. Lord, I have loved the beauty of Your house, and the place where Your glory dwells. Destroy not my soul with the ungodly, nor my life with bloody men: in whose hands is iniquity, and their right hand is full of bribes. But as for me, I have walked in my innocence: save me, and have mercy on me. For my feet have stood in uprightness: in the churches will I bless You, O Lord. Alleluia.

The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is He Who provides for my safety; of whom shall I be afraid? When they come near me to eat my flesh, those who trouble me and my enemies, they themselves became weak and fell. If an encampment should be arrayed against me, my heart shall not fear: if war should rise up against me, in this I have hope. One thing have I asked of the Lord, this also will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, that I may behold the joy of the Lord, and visit His holy temple. For He has hidden me in His tabernacle in the day of my evils: He has covered me in the hidden place of His tabernacle. He has exalted me upon a rock. And now, behold, He has exalted my head above my enemies. I went roundabout and I sacrificed in His tabernacle the sacrifice of rejoicing; I will praise, I will sing unto the Lord. Hear, O Lord, my voice with which I have cried: have mercy upon me, and hear me: for my heart has said unto You, I have sought after Your face: Your face, O Lord, do I seek after. Turn not Your face away from me; and turn not away from Your servant in anger: be You to me a helper; forsake me not, neither disregard me, O God my Saviour. For my father and my mother have forsaken me: but the Lord has received me. Set for me a Law, O Lord, in Your ways, and lead me in the path of uprightness, because of my enemies. Deliver me not over unto the souls of those who afflict me: for unjust witnesses have risen up against me, and injustice has lied to itself. I believe that I shall see the good things of the Lord in the land of the living. Wait on the Lord: be strong, and let your heart be strengthened: and wait on the Lord. Alleluia.

Bring unto the Lord, O you children of God, bring unto the Lord the offspring of rams. Bring unto the Lord glory and honour, bring unto the Lord the glory of His Name; worship the Lord in His holy court. The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory has thundered: the Lord (is) upon many waters. The voice of the Lord (is) in power; the voice of the Lord (is) in splendour. The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; the Lord will break the cedars of Lebanon. And He will break them into pieces like the calf of Lebanon, and the beloved like the son of a unicorn. The voice of the Lord divides the flame of fire. The voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness; the Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh. The voice of the Lord prepares the hinds, and lays bare the forests. In His holy temple every one utters glory. The Lord dwells in the flood; yea, the Lord shall sit as King for ever. The Lord will give strength unto His people; the Lord will bless His people with peace. Alleluia.

I will exalt You, O Lord; for You have received me, and have not made my enemies to rejoice over me. O Lord my God, I have cried unto You, and You have healed me. O Lord, You have brought up my soul from Amenti: You have saved me from the hands of those who go down into the pit. Sing unto the Lord, all you saints of His, and confess at the remembrance of His holiness. For wrath is in His anger, but in His will there is life: at night there will be weeping, but in the morning joy. And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved. Lord, by Your will You have given power to my beauty: You turned Your face away from me, and I became troubled. Unto You, O Lord, will I cry and unto my God will I make supplication. What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to corruption? Will the earth confess You? Or declare Your truth? The Lord heard, and has had mercy upon me: the Lord, became for me a helper. You have turned my mourning into joy for me: You have rent my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness. That my glory may sing to You, and I may not be grieved. O Lord my God, I will confess You for ever. Alleluia.

I will bless the Lord at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth. My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: let the meek hear and be glad. Ascribe greatness to the Lord with me, and let us exalt His Name together. I have sought the Lord, and He heard me, and delivered me from all my sojournings. Come unto Him, that you may be enlightened: and your faces shall not be ashamed. This poor man cried out, and the Lord heard him, and saved him from all his troubles. The angel of the Lord encamps round about everyone who fears Him, and He will deliver them. O taste and see that the Lord is sweet: blessed is the man that hopes in Him. Fear the Lord, all you His saints: for there is no want to those who fear Him. The rich have become poor and hungry: but they that seek the Lord shall not lack any good thing. Come, my children, listen to me: that I may teach you the fear of the Lord. Who is the man who desires life, who thinks about seeing good days? Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking deceit. Turn away from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it. For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and His ears are open unto their supplication. But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil, that He may wipe out the remembrance of them from the earth. The righteous cried out, and the Lord heard them, and delivered them from all their troubles. The Lord is near unto those who are contrite in their heart; the humble in spirit shall He save. Many are the afflictions of the righteous: and the Lord shall deliver them out of them all. The Lord will guard all their bones: not one of them shall perish. The death of sinners is evil: and they that hate the righteous shall regret1. The Lord will redeem the souls of His servants: and none of those who trust in Him shall regret. Alleluia.

Blessed is he who attends to the needy and the poor: in the evil day the Lord will deliver him. The Lord will guard him, and keep him alive; and make him blessed upon the earth: and deliver him not unto the hands of his enemies. The Lord will help him upon the bed of his sorrow: You have turned all his bed in his sickness. I, myself said, O Lord, have mercy upon me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against You. My enemies have spoken evil of me, saying, “When shall he die, and his name perish?” When he was coming to see me, he was speaking vanity: and his heart gathered iniquity unto himself; he was going out and he was speaking against me at once. All my enemies have whispered against me: they took council against me for evil. And words that are against the Law, they have established against me “He who sleeps, shall he rise up again?” For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, he who has eaten my bread, has lifted up his heel against me. But You, O Lord, have mercy upon me, and raise me up, and I will give them their recompense. By this have I known that You have delighted in me, because my enemy shall not rejoice over me. And as for me, because of my innocence You have accepted me and established me before You for ever. Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, to everlasting. So be it, so be it. Alleluia.

Judge me, O God, and avenge my cause against an unclean nation: and from a man unjust and deceitful deliver me. For You are my God and my strength: why have You cast me off? And why do I go sorrowful while my enemy troubles me? Send forth Your light and Your truth: they have guided me and brought me up to Your holy mountain, and to Your dwelling place. Then will I go unto the altar of God, before the face of God Who has given joy to my youth. I will confess to You upon the harp, O God my God. Why are you sad, O my soul? And why do you trouble me? Hope in God: for to Him will I confess. The salvation of my countenance is my God. Alleluia.

My heart has poured forth a good word: I will declare my works to the king: my tongue is the pen of a swift writing scribe. (You are) comely in beauty above the sons of men: grace is poured forth from Your lips: therefore God has blessed You for ever. Gird Your sword upon Your thigh, O Mighty One. With Your beauty and Your comeliness, draw it out, prosper and reign, because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and Your right hand shall guide You wonderfully. Your arrows are sharp, O Mighty One— under You shall people fall— in the heart of the king's enemies. Your throne, O God, is for ever and ever. A sceptre of uprightness is the sceptre of Your kingdom. Because You have loved righteousness, and have hated iniquity, therefore God, Your God, has anointed You with the oil of gladness above Your fellows. Myrrh, and stacte, and cassia, (smell) out of Your garments, from the ivory palaces, wherein the daughters of the kings have made You glad in Your honour. The queen stood at Your right hand arrayed in a vesture of inwoven gold, adorned in varied ways. Hearken, O daughter, and see, and incline your ear; and forget your own people, and your father's house; because the King has desired your beauty: for He Himself is your Lord. And the daughter of Tyre shall worship Him with gifts; the rich among the people of the earth shall entreat His countenance. All the glory of the king's daughter is within: clothed with gold-fringed garments, adorned in varied ways. Virgins shall be brought unto the King following her, all her companions shall be brought unto Him. They shall be brought with joy and rejoicing: they shall enter into the temple of the King. Instead of your fathers shall be your children, whom you may make princes in all the earth. And they shall remember Your Name in every generation and generation. Therefore shall the people confess to You, O God for ever and unto the age of ages. Alleluia

Our God is our refuge and our strength. He is our helper in our afflictions which have befallen us exceedingly. Therefore we shall not fear, should the earth tremble, and the mountains move into the midst of the seas. The waters roared and trembled, the mountains were shaken by His might. The flowing of the rivers shall make the city of God rejoice, the Most High has sanctified His dwelling place. And God is in the middle of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her countenance. The nations trembled, the kingdoms were moved: He uttered His voice, the earth shook. The Lord, the God of powers is with us; our protector is the God of Jacob. Come and behold the works of the Lord, what wonders He has established upon the earth. Who makes wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He will crush their bows, and break their weapons; their shields He shall burn in the fire. Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth. The Lord, the God of powers is with us; our protector is the God of Jacob. Alleluia.

Clap your hands, all you nations; shout unto God with the voice of rejoicing. For the Lord is exalted and awesome; He is a great King over all the earth. He has subdued the people under us, and the nations under our feet. He has chosen us for His inheritance, the beauty of Jacob whom He has loved. God has ascended with jubilation, the Lord with the sound of the trumpet. Sing unto our God, sing: sing unto our King, sing. For the Lord is King of all the earth, sing with understanding. For the Lord has reigned over all the nations: God sits upon His holy throne. The rulers of the people are gathered together with the God of Abraham: for the mighty ones of God have been greatly exalted in the earth. Alleluia.

Have mercy upon me, O God, according to Your great mercy: and according to the multitude of Your compassions You shall blot out my iniquity. You shall wash me thoroughly from my iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin. For I know my iniquity: and my sin is before me at all times. Against You alone have I sinned, and done evil before You: that You may be justified in Your words, and prevail when You are judged. For behold, I was conceived in iniquity; and in sin did my mother desire me. For behold, You have loved truth, the secret and the hidden things of Your wisdom, You have manifested unto me. You shall sprinkle me with Your hyssop, and I shall be clean: You shall wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow. You shall cause me to hear joy and gladness; and my humble bones shall rejoice. Turn Your face away from my sins, and all my iniquities You shall blot out. A pure heart You shall create in me, O God; and an upright spirit renew within me. Cast me not away from Your face; and take not Your Holy Spirit from me. Give me the joy of Your salvation; and strengthen me with a governing spirit. That I may teach the lawless Your ways; and the wicked shall turn to You. Deliver me from blood, O God, the God of my salvation: and my tongue shall rejoice in Your righteousness. O Lord, You shall open my lips; and my mouth shall declare Your praise. For if You had desired sacrifice; I would indeed have given it: but, You delight not in burnt offerings. A sacrifice of God is a broken spirit: a broken and a humble heart, God will not despise. Do good, O Lord, in Your good pleasure unto Zion: and may the walls of Jerusalem be built. Then shall You be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with oblation and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer calves upon Your altar. Alleluia.

God, save me by Your Name, and judge me in Your strength. O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth. For strangers have risen up against me, and the strong have sought after my soul: they have not set God before them. Behold, God will help me: the Lord is the protector of my soul. He shall bring back evil unto my enemies: and in Your truth wipe them out. Willingly will I sacrifice to You: I will confess Your Name, O Lord; for it is good. For You have delivered me out of all trouble: and my eyes have looked upon my enemies. Alleluia.

Have mercy upon me, O God, have mercy upon me: for my soul has trusted in You: and in the shadow of Your wings will I hope, until the iniquity passes. I will cry unto God Most High; to God Who has done good things for me. He has sent forth from heaven, and He has delivered me: and those who trample upon me, He has put to shame. God has sent forth His mercy and His truth. He has delivered my soul from among the lion cubs. I slept being troubled: the sons of men, their teeth are weapons and arrows, and their tongue a sharpened sword. Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; and Your glory above all the earth. They have prepared snares for my feet; and they have bowed down my soul: they have dug a pit before me, and they have fallen into it. My heart is prepared, O God, my heart is prepared: I will praise and sing in my glory. Arise, my glory, arise psaltery and harp: I will rise early. I will confess to You, O Lord, among the people: I will sing to You among the nations. For Your mercy is magnified unto the heavens, and Your truth unto the clouds. Be exalted, O God, above the heavens: and Your glory above all the earth. Alleluia.

Hear O God my supplication; attend unto my prayer. From the end of the earth I have cried aloud unto You, when my heart was grieved: You have exalted me upon a rock. You have led me: You have become my hope and a tower of strength from the face of the enemy. I will abide in Your dwelling-place for ever: I will take shelter under the covering of Your wings. For You, O God, have heard my prayers: You have given a heritage to those who fear Your Name. Days shall You add to the days of the king: and to his years days from generation to generation. And he shall abide before God for ever: His mercy and His truth who has sought after them? Thus will I sing unto Your Name unto the age of ages, that I may perform my vows from day to day. Alleluia.

O God, my God; unto You will I rise early: for my soul has thirsted for You. That my flesh may blossom for You in a barren land and an untrodden place, a place without water. Thus have I appeared before You, in the sanctuary, to see Your power and Your glory. For Your mercy is elect, better than life; my lips shall praise You. Therefore will I bless You in my life: in Your Name will I lift up my hands. My soul will be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and (my) joyful lips shall praise Your Name. I remembered You upon my bed, and at dawn I meditated on You: for You have been a help unto me, and in the shadow of Your wings will I rejoice. My soul has cleaved after You and Your right hand has supported me. But as for those who have sought after my soul in vain; they shall go into the lower parts of the earth, they shall be delivered into the hand of the sword, they shall become portions for foxes. But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that swears by Him shall boast: for the mouth of those who speak unjustly shall be stopped. Alleluia.

May God have compassion upon us, bless us, manifest His face upon us, and have mercy upon us. That Your way may be known upon the earth, and Your salvation among all nations. Let the people confess to You, O God; let all the people confess to You. Let the nations rejoice and be glad: for You shall judge the people uprightly, and guide the nations upon earth. Let the people confess to You, O God; let all the people confess to You. The earth has given its fruit. May God, our God, bless us; may God bless us: may all the ends of the earth fear Him. Alleluia.

O God, attend to my help; make haste O Lord to help me. Let them be ashamed and be scorned that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and be ashamed, that desire to do evil against me. Let them be turned back straightway in shame that say unto me, “Well! Well!” Let them rejoice and be glad in You: all who seek after You, and let them who love Your salvation say at all times, “Let the Lord be magnified.” But as for me, I am poor and feeble: O God help me. You are my helper and my deliverer; O Lord, make no delay. Alleluia.

How beloved are Your dwellings, O Lord, God of the powers! My soul yearns, and faints to enter into the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh have rejoiced in the living God. For the sparrow has found him a house, and the turtle dove a nest for herself, to lay her young: Your altars, O Lord, God of the powers, my King, and my God. Blessed are all who dwell in Your house: they shall praise You forever and ever. Blessed is the man whose support is from You, O Lord: he has established highways in his heart; in the valley of weeping, in the place in which he has established it. For the Law-giver shall give blessings: they shall go from strength to strength: the God of gods shall appear in Zion. O Lord, God of the powers, hear my prayer: hearken, O God of Jacob. Behold, O God our defender, and look upon the face of Your Christ. For a good day in Your courts is better than thousands. I have chosen for myself to be cast in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of the sinners. For the Lord God loves mercy and truth: and will give glory and grace. The Lord will not withhold the good thing from those who walk in innocence. O Lord, God of the powers, blessed is the man who hopes in You. Alleluia.

Lord, You have been pleased with Your land: You have brought back the captivity of Jacob. You have forgiven the iniquities of Your people, You have covered all their sins. You have taken away all Your anger: You have turned away from the anger of Your wrath. Turn us, O God of our salvation, and turn Your wrath away from us. Will You be angry with us for ever? Will You draw out Your anger from generation to generation? You, O God will turn and revive us again: and Your people will rejoice in You. Show us Your mercy, O Lord, and grant us Your salvation. I will hear what the Lord God will speak within me: for He will speak peace unto His people, and to His saints: and those who will turn to Him with all their hearts. For His salvation is near to everyone who fears Him; that glory may dwell in our land. Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have grasped hands with one another. Truth has sprung out of the earth; and righteousness has looked down from heaven. For the Lord shall give goodness; and our land shall give its fruit. Truth shall go before Him; and shall set His footsteps in the way. Alleluia.

Incline Your ear, O Lord, and hear me: for I am poor and weak. Preserve my soul; for I am pure: save Your servant my God, who hopes in You. Have mercy upon me, O Lord: for I have cried aloud unto You all the day. Rejoice the soul of Your servant: for unto You, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul. For You (are) good, Lord. You are meek; and plenteous is Your mercy unto all those who cry unto You. Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications. In the day of my trouble I have cried aloud unto You: for You have heard me. There is none like You, among the gods O Lord; neither is there any who can do like unto Your works. All nations whom You have made shall come and worship before You, O Lord; and shall glorify Your Name. For You are great, and do wonders: You, alone, are God the great. Lead me in Your way, O Lord; and I will walk in Your truth: let my heart be glad to fear Your Name. I will confess to You, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify Your Name for evermore. For great is Your mercy toward me: and You have delivered my soul from the lowest Amenti. O God, the breakers of the Law have risen against me, and the synagogue of the strong ones have sought after my soul; and have not set You before them. But You, O Lord, God, You are compassionate, and merciful. You are longsuffering, and plenteous in Your mercy and true. Look upon me, and have mercy upon me: give strength unto Your servant, and deliver the son of Your handmaid. Make with me a sign unto good; let those who hate me see, and be ashamed: because You, Lord, have helped me, and have comforted me. Alleluia.

His foundations are in the holy mountains. The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob. Honourable things are spoken of You, O city of God. I will remember Rahab and Babylon as those who know me: behold the strange tribes, and Tyre, and the people of Ethiopia, these were there. Mother Zion will say, that a man and a man has dwelt in her: and He is the Highest Who has founded her forever. The Lord shall declare, in the writings of the people and the rulers, those who dwelt in her. For the dwelling of all those who are glad is in you. Alleluia.

He who abides in the help of the Most High shall rest under the shadow of the God of heaven. He shall say to the Lord, You are my protector and my refuge: my God; in Him will I hope. For He will deliver me from the snare of the hunter, and from the troublesome word. He shall overshadow You in the midst of His shoulders, and under His wings you shall trust: His truth shall encompass you as a weapon. You shall not be afraid of the terror of the night; nor of the arrow that flies by day; nor of a thing that walks in the dark; nor of the destruction and the demon of the noon. Thousands shall fall at your left hand, and myriads at your right hand; but they shall not come near you. Rather with your eyes you will behold and see the reward of the sinners. For You, O Lord, are my hope. You have made the Most High, your refuge; no evil shall come to you, neither shall any scourge come near your dwelling. For He shall command His angels concerning you, to keep you in all your ways. They will bear you upon their hands, lest you stumble with your foot on a stone. You shall tread upon the serpent and the basilisk: and trample upon the lion and the dragon. Because he has hoped in Me, I will deliver him: I will cover him, because he has known My Name. He shall pray to Me, and I will hear him: I am with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and glorify him. With long life I will satisfy him, and show him My salvation. Alleluia.

The Lord has reigned, He has clothed Himself with beauty; the Lord has clothed Himself with power, and He has girded Himself with it: for He has set up the world, that it cannot be moved. Your throne is prepared from the beginning: and from everlasting are You. The rivers have raised themselves up, O Lord, the rivers have lifted up their voice; the rivers lift up their voices, more than the voice of many waters. Wonderful are the surges of the sea. Wonderful is the Lord in the highest. His testimonies are exceedingly faithful: holiness befits Your house, O Lord, unto length of days. Alleluia.

Sing unto the Lord a new song: sing unto the Lord, all the earth. Sing unto the Lord, praise His Name; preach His salvation from day to day. Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all people. For the Lord is great, and exceedingly blessed: He is fearful above all gods. For all the gods of the nations are demons: but the Lord, He created the heavens. Confession and beauty are before Him: purity and splendour are in His sanctuary. Bring unto the Lord, all you families of the nations, bring unto the Lord glory and honour. Bring unto the Lord glory to His Name: bring sacrifices and enter into His courts. Worship the Lord in His holy courts. Let all the earth be moved from before His face: say among the nations that the Lord has reigned from a Wood: for He has also set up the world that it shall not be moved: He shall judge the people in uprightness. Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; let the sea be moved, and all its fullness. Let the plains rejoice, and everything that is in them: then all the trees of the wood shall rejoice, before the Lord: for He comes, for He comes to judge the earth: He shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with His truth. Alleluia.

The Lord has reigned; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of islands be glad. Clouds and darkness are round about Him: righteousness and judgment are the foundation of His throne. A fire shall proceed before Him, and with a flame shall burn up His enemies who surround Him. His lightenings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and moved. The mountains melted like wax from before the face of the Lord, from before the face of the Lord of all the earth. The heavens have declared His righteousness, and all the people have seen His glory. All they who worship things made with hands shall be ashamed: they who boast themselves in their idols. Worship Him, all His angels. Zion heard, and was glad; the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of Your judgements, O Lord. For You are the Lord, Who is exalted above all the earth: You are exalted exceedingly above all gods. You who love the Lord, hate evil: for the Lord shall guard the souls of His saints; and He shall deliver them from the hands of the sinners. A light has risen for the righteous, and joy for those who are upright in their heart. Be glad in the Lord, you righteous; and confess at the remembrance of His holiness. Alleluia.

Sing unto the Lord a new song; for the Lord has done wondrous works: His right hand, and His holy arm, have revived Him. The Lord has manifested His salvation before the nations: and has revealed His righteousness to them. He has remembered His mercy to Jacob and His righteousness to the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God. Shout aloud unto the Lord, all the earth: praise, and rejoice, and sing. Sing unto the Lord with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm. With loud trumpets and a sound of the horn trumpet, shout aloud before the Lord, the King. Let the sea be moved, and all its fulness; the world, and everyone that dwells in it. The rivers shall clap their hands together: and the mountains shall rejoice before the Lord; for He has come to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, and the people with uprightness. Alleluia.

The Lord has reigned; let the people rage: He Who sits upon the Cherubim; let the earth be moved. Great is the Lord in Zion; and He is exalted above all the people. Let them confess His great Name; for It is fearful and holy. And the honour of the King loves judgment; You have prepared uprightness: judgment and righteousness You have performed in Jacob. Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at the footstool of His feet; for it is holy. Moses and Aaron among His priests, and Samuel among those who entreat His Name; they were entreating the Lord, and He was hearkening to them, in a pillar of cloud He was speaking to them: for they had kept His testimonies, and the commandments which He gave to them. O Lord our God, You were hearkening to them: You, O God, have become unto them, a forgiver and an avenger of all their works. Exalt the Lord our God: worship at His holy mountain; for the Lord our God is holy. Alleluia.

Shout aloud unto the Lord, all the earth: serve the Lord with gladness: come before Him with rejoicing. Know that the Lord He is God: He has created us, and not we ourselves; for we are His people, and the sheep of His fold. Enter into His gates with confession, and into His courts with praise: confess to Him, and bless His Name. For the Lord is good; His mercy is everlasting; and His truth is from generation to generation. Alleluia.

I will praise You, O Lord: mercy and judgment, will I sing. And I will understand in a blameless way. When will You come unto me? I was walking in innocence of my heart within my house. I have not set an unlawful thing before my eyes: I have hated those who work transgression; no crooked heart has cleaved unto me. The evil will turn aside from me, I did not know (it). He who privately slanders his neighbour, him I drove away: with him that had a proud eye and a puffed up heart, I would not eat. My eyes were upon the faithful of the earth, that they may sit with me: he that walks in a blameless way, he was serving me. He who acts proudly did not dwell within my house: he that speaks unjust things was not established before my eyes. In the hours of the morning I was slaying all the sinners of the land; that I may cut off from the city of the Lord everyone that works iniquity. Alleluia.

The Lord said to my Lord, sit at My right hand, until I put Your enemies beneath Your feet. A rod of Your power the Lord shall send forth from Zion: and You shall rule in the midst of Your enemies. With You is the dominion in the day of Your power, in the brightness of the saints: from the womb, before the star of the morning, I have begotten You. The Lord has sworn, and will not repent, You are the priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek. The Lord at Your right hand has crushed kings in the day of His wrath. He will judge among the nations, He shall fill them with corpses; He shall crush the heads of many upon the earth. He shall drink water on the way from a spring: therefore He will lift up the head. Alleluia.

I will confess to You, O Lord, with all my heart, in the council of those who are upright, and in their synagogue. Great are the works of the Lord: all His wishes are sought out. Confession and splendour is His work: and His righteousness endures for ever. He has made a memorial of His wonders: the Lord is merciful and com- passionate. He has given food to those who fear Him: He will ever be mindful of His covenant. The power of His works, He has made known to His people: that He may give them the heritage of the nations. The works of His hands are truth and judgment; all His commandments are faithful: they are confirmed unto the age of ages: they are done in truth and uprightness. He has sent redemption to His people: He has commanded His covenant for ever: holy and fearful is His Name. The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding has everyone who does it: and His praise endures for ever and ever. Alleluia.

Blessed is the man who fears the Lord: in His commandments he shall exceedingly delight. His seed shall be strengthened upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed. Glory and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endures for ever and ever. A light has risen in the darkness for those who are upright: merciful and compassionate and just is the Lord God. Good is the man that shows compassion, and lends: he shall order his words with judgement. For he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance. He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is ready to hope in the Lord. His heart is established, and he shall not be moved, until he look upon his enemies. He has distributed, he has given to the poor; and his righteousness endures for ever; his horn shall be exalted with glory. The sinner shall see it, and be angry; he shall gnash his teeth, and shall melt away: the desire of the sinner shall perish. Alleluia.

Praise the Lord, O you children, praise the Name of the Lord. May the Name of the Lord be blessed from now and for ever. From the rising of the sun until its setting, praise the Name of the Lord. The Lord is exalted above all nations; His glory is above the heavens. Who is like unto the Lord our God, Who dwells in the highest and looks upon the lowly, in the heaven, and upon the earth; Who has raised up the poor out of the earth, and lifts the needy out of the dunghill; that He may seat him with rulers, with the rulers of his people. Who makes the barren woman to dwell in the house of a joyful mother of children. Alleluia.

I have loved, because the Lord has heard the voice of my supplication. Because He has inclined His ear unto me, and in my days I entreated Him. For the sorrows of death held me, and the perils of Amenti have found me: I found trouble and grief. And I entreated the Name of the Lord; O Lord, deliver my soul. Merciful is the Lord, and righteous; our God shows mercy. He Who keeps the little children is The Lord: I humbled myself, and He delivered me. Return, O my soul unto Your resting place; for the Lord has done good unto me. He has delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from stumbling. I will please the Lord in the region of the living. Alleluia.

I believed, therefore I spoke: I was also exceedingly humbled: I said in my amazement: all men are liars. What shall I give to the Lord in return for all He has given me? I will take the cup of salvation, and entreat the Name of the Lord. I will pay my vows unto the Lord before all the people. Precious before the Lord is the death of His saints. Lord, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, and the son of Your handmaid: You have broken my bonds. I will sacrifice to You the sacrifice of praise, and will entreat the Name of the Lord. I will pay my vows unto the Lord, in the courts of the house of the Lord before all the people, in the midst of Jerusalem. Alleluia.
Praise the Lord, all you nations: praise Him, all you people. For His mercy is confirmed upon us: and the truth of the Lord endures for ever. Alleluia.

Confess unto the Lord; for He is good: because His mercy endures for ever. Let the house of Israel say, that He is good: that His mercy endures for ever. Let the house of Aaron say, that He is good: that His mercy endures for ever. Let those who fear the Lord say, that He is good: that His mercy endures for ever. In my trouble, I have cried unto the Lord: and He has heard me, and brought me into a broad place. The Lord is my helper; I will not fear: what can man do to me? The Lord is my helper; and I will look upon my enemies. It is better to trust in the Lord than to trust in man. It is better to hope in the Lord than to hope in rulers. All nations surrounded me: but in the Name of the Lord I took my vengeance upon them. They surrounded me and compassed me about; and in the Name of the Lord I took my vengeance upon them. They surrounded me like bees around a honeycomb; and they burned as a fire in thorns: and in the Name of the Lord I took my vengeance upon them. They laid their hands on me that I might fall: but the Lord supported me. My strength and my praise is the Lord, He has become to me salvation. The voice of rejoicing and salvation in the dwellings of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord has made strength. The right hand of the Lord has exalted me: the right hand of the Lord has made strength. I shall not die, but I shall live, and I shall declare the works of the Lord. For with chastening the Lord has chastened me: but He has not delivered me over to death. Open to me the gates of righteousness: that I may go into them, and confess to the Lord: this is the gate of the Lord, the righteous shall enter into it. I shall confess You, Lord: for You have heard me, and have become to me salvation. The stone which the builders despised, the same is become the head of the corner. This is the Lord's doing; and it is marvellous in our eyes. This is the day which the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it. O Lord, You shall save us, O Lord, You shall straighten our way. Blessed be He Who comes in the Name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord. God the Lord, has enlightened us. Ordain a feast, in those who reach unto the horns of the altar. You are my God, and I will confess You: You are my God, I will exalt You. I shall confess You, Lord: for You have heard me, and have become to me salvation. Confess unto the Lord; for He is good: because His mercy endures for ever. Alleluia.

Blessed (are) the blameless in the way, who walk in the Law of the Lord. Blessed (are) they who search out His testimonies, who seek Him with all their heart. For those who work iniquity have not desired to walk in His ways. You have commanded Your ordinances to be kept diligently. O that my ways were upright to keep Your truths! Then I shall not be ashamed, when I look upon all Your commandments. I will confess You, O Lord, with uprightness of my heart, on knowing the judgements of Your justice. And Your truths I will keep: forsake me not utterly. O Lover of mankind)

By what shall a youth straighten his way? By keeping Your words. I have sought after You with all my heart: cast me not away from Your commandments. I have hidden Your words in my heart, that I might not sin against You. Blessed are You, Lord: teach me Your truths. With my lips I have confessed all the judgements of Your mouth. I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies, as over all riches. I will speak of Your commandments, and I will understand Your ways. I will meditate upon Your truths: and I will not forget Your words. O Lover of mankind)

Repay Your servant, (and) I shall live, and I shall keep Your word. Open my eyes, and I shall behold Your wonders out of Your Law. I, myself, am a sojourner upon the earth: hide not Your commandments from me. My soul has yearned after longing for Your judgements at all times. You have rebuked the proud: cursed are those who have turned away from Your com- mandments. Remove from me reproach and shame; for I have sought after Your testimonies. For rulers also were sitting, they were speaking against me: but Your servant meditated in Your truths. For Your testimonies also are my study, and Your truths are my counsels. O Lover of mankind)

My soul has cleaved to the earth: revive me according to Your word. I have declared Your ways, and You have heard me: teach me Your truths. And make me to understand the way of Your justice: and I will meditate on Your wonders. My soul has slumbered from grief: strengthen me by Your words. Cast away from me the way of unrighteousness: and by Your Law have mercy on me. I have chosen the way of truth: and I have not forgotten Your judgements. I have cleaved to Your testimonies: Lord, put me not to shame. I was running in the way of Your com- mandments, when You enlarged my heart. O Lover of mankind)

Set before me a Law, O Lord, in the way of Your truths, and I will seek after it at all times. Give me understanding, and I shall search Your Law; and I shall keep it with all my heart. Lead me to the way of Your commandments; for those I have desired. Incline my heart to Your testimonies, and not to covetousness. Turn away my eyes that they behold not vanities; and revive me in Your way. Establish Your word with Your servant unto Your fear. Turn away my reproach which I suspected: for Your judgements are sweet. Behold, I have desired Your commandments: revive me in Your righteousness. O Lover of mankind)

Let Your mercy come upon me, O Lord, and Your salvation, according to Your word. And I shall answer a word to those who scorn me: for I have hoped in Your words. And take not away from my mouth the word of truth utterly; for I have hoped in Your judgements. And I will keep Your Law at all times for ever and ever. I was walking at large: for I have sought after Your commandments. I was speaking of Your testimonies before kings, and I was not ashamed. And I was meditating on Your commandments, which I have loved exceedingly. I have lifted up my hands unto Your commandments, which I have loved exceedingly; and I was meditating on Your truths. O Lover of mankind)

Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have caused me to hope. That which has comforted me in my humiliation: for Your word has revived me. The proud have transgressed the Law utterly: but I have not turned away from Your Law. I have remembered Your judgements of old, O Lord; and I was comforted. Grief has taken hold upon me because of the sinners who have forsaken Your Law. Your truths have been psalms unto me in the place of my dwelling. I have remembered Your Name, O Lord, in the night, and I have kept Your Law. This happened to me, because I have sought after Your truths. O Lover of mankind)

You are my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep Your commandments. I have entreated Your face with all my heart: have mercy upon me according to Your word. I have thought on Your ways, and I have turned my feet unto Your testimonies. I am prepared and I have not been troubled: That I may keep Your commandments. The bonds of sinners have wrapped me round: but I have not forgotten Your Law. At midnight I used to rise to confess You because of the judgements of Your righteousness. I am a companion to every one who fears You, and those who keep Your commandments. The earth, is filled of Your mercy O Lord, teach me Your truths. O Lover of mankind)

You have made goodness with Your servant, O Lord, according to Your word. Teach me sweetness and discipline and knowledge: for I have believed Your commandments. Before I was humbled I was neglectful: therefore I have kept Your words. You are sweet, Lord, and in Your goodness teach me Your truths. The injustice of the proud has been multiplied against me: but I will search Your commandments with my whole heart. Their heart is curdled like milk; but I have meditated on Your Law. It is good for me that I have been humbled; that I might learn Your truths. The Law of Your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver. O Lover of mankind)

Your hands have formed me and created me: give me understanding, that I may learn Your commandments. Those who fear You shall see me, and they shall be glad; because I have hoped in Your words. I have known, O Lord, that Your judgements are righteous, and in truth You have humbled me. Let Your mercy come upon me to comfort me, according to Your word unto Your servant. Let Your compassion come to me, that I may live: for Your Law is my meditation. Let the proud be ashamed; for they have unjustly transgressed against me: but I will be continuing in Your commandments. Let those who fear You and those who know Your wonders turn unto me, let my heart be pure in Your truth; that I be not ashamed. O Lover of mankind)

My soul has fainted for Your salvation: and I have hoped in Your word. My eyes have failed for Your words, saying, “When will You comfort me?” I have become like a wineskin in the frost; but I have not forgotten Your truths. How many are the days of Your servant? When will You execute judgment on those who persecute me? The lawless have spoken to me idle words, but not as Your Law, O Lord. For all Your commandments are truth: they persecute me unjustly; help me. They had almost destroyed me upon the earth; but I did not forsake Your commandments. According to Your mercy revive me; and I shall keep the testimonies of Your mouth. O Lover of mankind)

Your word, O Lord, endures for ever in the heavens. And Your truth abides from generation to generation: You have founded the earth, and it abides. By Your ordinance the day exists: for all things serve You. Unless Your Law had been my meditation, I should have perished in my humiliation. I will never forget Your truths: for by them You have revived me, O Lord. I am Yours, O Lord, save me; for I have sought after Your truths. The sinners have waited for me to destroy me: but I have understood Your testimonies. I have seen an end of all perfec- tion: but Your commandments are exceedingly broad. O Lover of mankind)

O how loveable is Your Name, O Lord! It is my meditation all the day. You have instructed me in Your commandments more than my enemies: for they abide with me forever. I have understood more than all those who instruct me: for Your testimonies are my meditation. I have understood more than the elders, for I have sought after Your commandments. I have restrained my feet from every evil way, that I may keep Your words. I have not turned away from Your judgements: for You have set me a Law. How sweet are Your words to my palate! Better than honey and honeycomb to my mouth! I have been instructed by Your commandments: therefore I have hated every way of injustice, for You have set a Law for me. O Lover of mankind)

Your Law is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my ways. I have sworn, and I have confirmed it, that I will keep the judgements of Your truth. I have been humbled exceedingly: revive me, Lord, according to Your word. The vows of my mouth You will bless, O Lord, and teach me Your judgements. My soul is in Your hands at all times: and I have not forgotten Your Law. The sinners have concealed a snare for me: and I have not strayed from Your commandments. Your testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart. I have inclined my heart to perform Your righteousness, for the sake of an eternal reward. O Lover of mankind)

Transgressors have I hated: but Your Law I have loved. For You are my helper and my protector: I have hoped in Your words. Depart from me, you evildoers: and I shall search out the commandments of my God. Receive me according to Your word, and I shall live: and let me not be ashamed of my expectation. Help me, and I shall be saved: and I shall meditate on Your truths at all times. You have despised all who have turned away from Your truths: for their thought is iniquity. All the sinners of the earth I have counted as transgressors: therefore I have loved Your testimonies at all times. Nail Your fear into my flesh; for I am afraid of Your judgements. O Lover of mankind)

I have done judgement and justice: leave me not to those who oppress me. Be surety for Your servant unto good: let not the proud slander me. My eyes have failed for Your salvation, and for the word of Your righteousness. Deal with Your servant according to Your mercy, and teach me Your truths. I am Your servant; give me understanding, and I shall know Your testimonies. It is time for the Lord to work: for they have made void Your Law. Therefore I have loved Your commandments above gold and precious stone. Therefore I have stood by all Your commandments; all ways of iniquity have I hated. O Lover of mankind)

Wonderful are Your testimonies: therefore my soul has examined them. The revelation of Your words enlightens me; and shall give understanding unto the little children. I have opened my mouth, and I have drawn unto me a Spirit: for I have longed for Your commandments. Look upon me, and have mercy upon me, according to the judgement of those who love Your Name. You shall make straight my footsteps according to Your word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me. Deliver me from the falsehood of men: and I will keep Your commandments. Let Your face shine upon Your servant; and teach me Your truths. My eyes have cast down streams of waters, because they have not kept Your Law. O Lover of mankind)

Righteous are You, O Lord, and upright are Your judgements. You have exceedingly commanded justice and truth, which are Your testimonies. The zeal of Your house has consumed me, because my enemies have forgotten Your commandments. Your word is exceedingly refined: and Your servant has loved it. I am a youth and despised: but I have not forgotten Your truths. Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Your word is truth. Trouble and distress have overtaken me: yet Your commandments are my meditation. Righteous are Your testimonies unto the age: give me understanding, and I shall live. O Lover of mankind)

I have cried out with all my heart; hear me, O Lord: Your truths will I seek after. I cried unto You; save me, and I will keep Your testimonies. I anticipated a time not yet: I cried and I hoped in Your word. My eyes have anticipated the hour of the morning to meditate on Your words. Hear my voice O Lord, according to Your mercy: and revive me according to Your judgements. They that persecute me have drawn near to iniquity: they are far from Your Law. You are near, O Lord; and all Your commandments are truth. From the beginning I have known concerning Your testimonies, that You have founded them for ever. O Lover of mankind)

Behold my lowliness, and deliver me: for I have not forgotten Your Law. Judge my cause, and redeem me: revive me for the sake of Your word. Salvation is far from the sinners: for they have not sought after Your truths. Exceedingly abundant are Your compassions, O Lord: revive me according to Your judgements. Many are those who persecute me and trouble me; I have not turned away from Your testimonies. I have seen the ignorant, and I was grieved; because they kept not Your words. Behold, Lord, how I have loved Your commandments: revive me, O Lord, in Your mercy. The beginning of Your words is truth: and all the judgements of Your righteousness endure for ever. O Lover of mankind)

Rulers have persecuted me without a cause: and my heart has been in awe of Your words. I will rejoice at Your words, as one who finds a multitude of spoils. I have hated injustice and have abhorred it: but Your Law have I loved. Seven times a day have I praised You because of the judgements of Your righteousness. Let there be great peace to those who love Your Name: and let there be no stumbling block for them. I was looking for Your salvation, Lord, and Your commandments have I kept. My soul has kept Your testimonies; and loved them exceedingly. I have kept Your commandments and Your testimonies: for all my ways are before You, O Lord. O Lover of mankind)

Let my supplication come near before You, O Lord: give me understanding according to Your word. My petition shall come in before You: revive me according to Your word. My lips shall pour forth blessing, if You teach me Your truths. My tongue shall respond with Your words: for all Your commandments are righteous. Let Your hand be unto delivering me; for I have desired Your commandments. I have longed for Your salvation, Lord; and Your Law is my meditation. My soul shall live, and it shall praise You; and Your judgements shall help me. I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek after Your servant; for I have not forgotten Your commandments. Alleluia

In my trouble I cried unto You, Lord, and You have heard me. O Lord, deliver my soul, from iniquitous lips, and from a deceit- ful tongue. What shall be given to you? Or what shall be added unto you, by a deceitful tongue? The sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of the desert. Woe unto me, that my sojourn is prolonged: I have dwelt in the dwellings of Kedar! My soul has been a sojourner in a multitude of places. With those who hated peace, I was peaceable: when I spoke with them, they fought against me in vain. Alleluia.

I have lifted up my eyes unto the mountains, from where comes my help. My help is from the Lord, Who created the heaven and the earth. Let not your foot be moved: He Who keeps you will not slumber. Behold, He Who watches over Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep. The Lord shall keep you: the Lord shall be a shade upon your right hand. By day, the sun shall not burn you, nor the moon by night. The Lord shall guard you from all evil: the Lord shall guard your soul. The Lord shall guard your coming in and your going out from now and for ever. Alleluia.

I was gladdened by what they said to me: we will go into the house of the Lord. Our feet stood in the courts of Jerusalem. Jerusalem is built as a city: her good pleasure is in this and that: for to there had the tribes gone up, the tribes of the Lord, a testimony of Israel, to confess the Name of the Lord. For there are set thrones of judgment, thrones over the house of David. Seek after that which belongs to your peace, Jerusalem: and abundance for those who love you. Let peace be in your strength, and abundance in your heavy towers. For the sake of my brethren and my relatives, I have spoken peace concerning you. For the sake of the house of the Lord our God I have sought after good things concerning you. Alleluia.

I have lifted up my eyes unto You Who dwells in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants on the hands of their masters, and as the eyes of a handmaiden on the hand of her mistress; so our eyes (are) unto the Lord our God, until He has compassion upon us. Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt, and our soul is exceedingly filled. Give the reproach to those who are prosperous, and the contempt to the proud. Alleluia.

Except the Lord had been with us, let Israel say; except the Lord had been with us, when men rose up against us: they would have swallowed us alive, when their wrath raged against us: the water would have submerged us, our soul would have passed through a torrent: Our soul would have passed through bottomless water. Blessed be the Lord, Who has not given us as a prey to their teeth. Our soul has escaped as a sparrow from the snare of the hunters: the snare is crushed, and we have escaped. Our help is in the Name of the Lord, Who created the heaven and the earth. Alleluia.

Those who trust in the Lord are like mount Zion: He who dwells in Jerusalem shall not be moved for ever. Mountains surround her, and the Lord is round about His people from now and for ever. The Lord shall not leave the rod of the sinners (rest) upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous stretch forth their hands unto iniquity. Do good, O Lord, to the good, and to those who are upright in their hearts. But those who sway into stumbling blocks, the Lord will remove them with evil doers: but peace (be) upon Israel. Alleluia.

When the Lord brought back the captivity of Zion, we became like those who are comforted. Then our mouth was filled with joy, and our tongue with rejoicing: then shall be said among the nations, that the Lord has magnified His doings with them. The Lord has magnified His doings with us; we have become joyful. The Lord shall bring back our captivity, like torrents in the south. Those who sow in tears shall reap in joy. Going, they went and they were weeping, bearing their seeds; coming, they will come with joy, bearing their sheaves. Alleluia.

Unless the Lord build the house, they labour in vain who build it: unless the Lord guard the city, those who guard it watch in vain. It is vain for you to rise up early, rise up, after being seated, who eat the bread of grief: for He gives sleep to His beloved ones. Lo, sons are the heritage of the Lord: the reward of the fruit of the womb. As arrows in the hand of a mighty one; so are children of those who have been awakened. Blessed is the man who shall fulfil his desire with them. Then they shall not be ashamed, when they speak with their enemies in the gates. Alleluia.

Blessed are all who fear the Lord; who walk in His ways. You will eat of the fruit of your labours: you will be blessed, and it shall be well with you. Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine blossoming forth by the sides of your house: your children like olive shoots around your table. Behold, thus shall be blessed the man who fears the Lord. The Lord shall bless you out of Zion: and you shall see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of your life. You shall see your children's children, and peace be upon Israel. Alleluia.

Many a time have they fought against me from my youth, let Israel say: many a time have they fought against me from my youth: Yet they could not prevail against me. The sinners were striking me upon my back: and they lengthened their iniquity. The Lord is righteous: He will break the necks of the sinners. Let them be ashamed and turned back all who hate Zion. Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withers before it is plucked up: with which the reaper has not filled his hand; Neither has he who gathers sheaves filled his bosom. And those who pass by have not said, “The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we have blessed you in the Name of the Lord.” Alleluia.

Out of the depths I have cried unto You, O Lord. Lord, hear my voice: let Your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplication. If You, Lord, should pay heed to iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand? For my forgiveness is from You, for Your Name’s sake, O Lord, I have waited for You. My soul has held firmly upon Your Law, my soul has hoped in the Lord, from the morning watch till the night. From the morning watch, let Israel hope in the Lord: for mercy is with the Lord, and great is His redemption. And He shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities. Alleluia.

Lord, my heart has not been exalted, nor have my eyes exalted themselves: neither have I exercised myself in great matters, nor in wonders above me. Yet, if I have not been humbled, but my voice has been raised as he who has been weaned from the milk towards his mother: In this manner recompense my soul. Let Israel hope in the Lord from this time and for ever. Alleluia.

Remember, O Lord, David and all his meekness: how he swore to the Lord, and vowed to the God of Jacob; I will not enter into the dwelling of my house, nor go up upon the bed of my sleeping-mat; I will not give sleep to my eyes, and slumber to my eyelids, and rest to my temples, until I find a place for the Lord, and a habitation for the God of Jacob. Behold, we have heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the place of the forest. We will go into His tabernacles: we will worship in the place where His feet stood. Arise, O Lord, to Your rest; You, and the ark of Your holy place. Your priests shall be clothed with righteousness; and Your saints shall rejoice. For the sake of Your servant David, turn not Your face away from Your Christ. The Lord has sworn to David in truth; and He will not turn from it; of the fruit of your belly will I set upon your throne. If your sons will keep My covenant and My testimonies that I shall teach them, their sons shall also sit upon your throne for evermore. For the Lord has chosen Zion; He has chosen it for His habitation. This is My place of rest to the age of ages. Here will I dwell; for I have desired it. Her widow with a blessing will I bless: and her poor I will satisfy with bread. Her priests I will clothe with salvation: and her saints shall rejoice with rejoicing. There will I raise up a horn to David: I have prepared a lamp for My Christ. His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon Him My holiness shall blossom. Alleluia.

Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together! Like precious ointment upon the head, which comes down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron: which comes down to the edge of his garment; as the dew of Hermon, which comes down upon the mountain of Zion: for there the Lord has commanded the blessing, and life for evermore. Alleluia.

Behold, bless the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, who stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God. In the nights, lift up your hands to the sanctuary, and bless the Lord. The Lord will bless you out of Zion, Who has created the heaven and the earth. Alleluia.

By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down and we wept, when we remembered Zion. Upon the willows in its midst we hanged our harps. For those who led us captive asked us there for words of songs: and they who had taken us there: sing to us a praise of the songs of Zion. How shall we sing the praise of the Lord in a strange land? If I forget Jerusalem, I shall forget my right hand. My tongue shall cleave to my throat if I do not remember you, if I place not Jerusalem first at the beginning of my joy. Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, trash it, trash it, even to its foundation. O wretched daughter of Babylon, blessed is he who shall reward you the same reward you have given us. Blessed is he who shall seize your little children and bury them beside the rock. Alleluia.

I will confess You, O Lord, with all my heart, for You have heard all the words of my mouth: before the angels I will sing to You. And I will worship before Your holy temple, and I will confess Your Name on account of Your mercy and Your truth: for You have magnified Your holy Name above every one. In the day when I shall entreat You, speedily hear me, You shall look the more upon my soul with power. Let all the kings of the earth confess You, O Lord, for they have heard all the words of my mouth. Let them praise in the ways of the Lord: for great is the glory of the Lord. For the Lord is exalted, and He beholds the lowly: and He knows them who are (exalted) from afar. Though I walk in the midst of trouble, You will revive me: You have stretched forth Your hand against the wrath of the enemies, and Your right hand has delivered me. The Lord will repay for me: Your mercy, O Lord, endures for ever: forsake not the works of Your own hands. Alleluia.

Lord, I have cried unto You, hear me: attend to the voice of my supplication when I cry aloud unto You. Let my prayer be set forth before You as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as an evening sacrifice. Set a watch, O Lord, over my mouth; and a strong door across my lips. Incline not my heart to evil words, to find occasion for excuses in sins with men who work iniquity: and I shall not take pleasure with their elect. The righteous shall chasten me in mercy; and shall reprove me: the oil of a sinner, let it not anoint my head: for my prayer also shall be in pleasure. Their strong ones have been swallowed up beside the rock, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet. As a clod of earth crushed on the ground, their bones are scattered beside Amenti. For our eyes are towards You, O Lord. Lord, I have hoped in You; slay not my soul. Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, and from the stumbling-blocks of those who work iniquity. Sinners shall fall in his net, I, myself, remain alone until the iniquity passes on. Alleluia.

I have cried aloud unto the Lord with my voice; with my voice I made supplication to the Lord. I will pour out my prayer before Him; my trouble will I pour out before Him. When my spirit perished within me, then You knew my paths. In this way in which I was walking have they hidden a snare for me.
