I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; there was no one who has regard for my soul. I have cried unto You, O Lord and I said, You are my hope and my portion in the land of the living. Attend unto my prayer; for I have been exceedingly humbled: deliver me from the hands of those who persecute me; for they have strengthened (themselves) more than I. Bring my soul out of prison, that I may confess Your Name, O Lord: the righteous wait for me; until You repay me. Alleluia.

Hear my prayer, O Lord, give ear to my supplications in Your truth. Hear me in Your righteousness, and enter not into judgment with Your servant: for none living shall be justified before You. For the enemy has pursued after my soul; he has humbled my life down to the earth; he has made me to sit in dark places, as those that have been dead of old. My spirit is anguished within me; my heart is troubled within me. I remembered the days of old; I meditated on all Your works; I meditated on the creations of Your hands. I spread forth my hands unto You: my soul has become like a land without water unto You. Hear me speedily, O Lord: for my spirit has failed: turn not Your face from me, lest I be like those who go down into the pit. Cause me to hear Your mercy in the morning; for in You have I hoped: instruct me, O Lord, in the way wherein I should walk; for unto You have I lifted up my soul. Deliver me, O Lord, from the hands of my enemies: for I have fled unto You. Teach me to do Your will; for You are my God: let Your Holy Spirit lead me unto uprightness. Revive me, O Lord, for Your Name's sake: in Your truth bring my soul out of trouble, and in Your mercy You shall cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul: for I am Your servant. Alleluia.

Praise the Lord, my soul. I will praise the Lord in my life: I will sing to my God while I have any being. Put not your trust in rulers, nor in the sons of men, in whom there is no salvation. Their spirit shall go out, and they shall return to their earth; in that day all their thoughts shall perish. Blessed is he whose helper is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God: Who has created the heaven, and the earth, the sea, and all that is in it: Who keeps truth for ever: Who executes judgment for those who suffer injustice: Who gives food to the hungry. The Lord shall loose the bound: The Lord shall raise those who are cast down: the Lord makes wise the blind: the Lord loves the righteous: the Lord shall keep the strangers; the orphan and the widow He shall accept: and the way of the sinners He shall destroy. The Lord shall reign for ever, and your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Alleluia.

Praise the Lord: for psalm is good: praise shall delight our God. He Who builds up Jerusalem is the Lord: the Lord will gather together the scattered of Israel. Who heals the broken in their hearts, and binds up all their bruises. Who numbers the multitude of the stars; and gives names to all of them. Great is the Lord, and great is His power: and infinite is His understanding. The Lord accepts the meek: but He humiliates the sinners down to the earth. Begin, first by confessing to the Lord; sing to our God with a harp: Who covers the heaven with clouds, Who prepares rain for the earth, Who makes grass to grow upon the mountains, and herbs for the service of men. And gives the beasts their food, and to the young ravens which cry unto Him. He shall not delight in the strength of the horse: nor take pleasure in the legs of a man. The Lord takes pleasure in those who fear Him, and those who hope in His mercy. Alleluia.

Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion. For He has strengthened the bars of your gates; He has blessed your children within you. Who set your borders in peace, and satisfies you with the fat of wheat. Who sends His word to the earth: His word runs very swiftly. Who gives snow like wool: Who pours down mist like ashes. And casts icicles like crumbs: Who can stand before the face of His frost? He will send His word, and will melt them: His wind will blow, and the waters will flow. Who declares His word to Jacob, His truths and His judgements to Israel. He has not dealt thus with every nation: and His judgements He has not manifested to them. Alleluia.
